## What it is

The mounting ring. Four M3 holes on the deck's 76.2 mm square, a Ø19 window on the light-cable hole, and four diamond pins.

## Design notes

- The pins are 8 × 8 mm diamonds, 5.66 mm across the flats, at 22 mm from the centre. The hole in each tower is 0.2 mm larger across the flats. That is a design allowance, not a measured fit.
- Each pin has a groove facing outward. The tower's tooth only enters that groove one way, so the tower cannot be turned 180°.
- Each pad has one lug pocket, at a different radius. The matching tower's lug drops in. A different tower's lug lands on solid ring.
- The window is Ø19 at (+11.71, +32.24). The deck hole under it is Ø15.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't fill the middle of the ring. The cable window has to stay open.
- Don't use round pins. The socket is horizontal when the tower prints on its side, and a round crown needs support.
- Don't drill this for the original spiral's Ø6.35 mm screws. This deck is M3.
